mainQuestExcel.title: Timaeus' Alchemy Tutorial
mainQuestExcel.description: Timaeus is deeply enraptured with alchemy. He wonders it there are others like him, that are drawn to this ancient and mysterious art...

dialogs.text: I want to find out more about alchemy.
The ancient art of alchemy is simply captivating... I wish more people appreciated it.
Oh, you're into alchemy too?
Very much so.
#Well then, {M#boy}{F#girl}, it's time for you to get some first-hand experience!
All great accomplishments start with a firm grasp of the basics and go from there.
Let's have you start by making some Shocking Essential Oil.
It is a foundational alchemical product. The best place for beginners to start.
To make Shocking Essential Oil, you will need some electro crystal and a frog.
Both can be easily found outside the city— What? You can't see a connection between crystal and essential oil?
Hahaha, that's because there is none! The electro crystal is for the shocking part; it's the frog that provides the essential oil.
Once you've gathered everything, try and create some Shocking Essential Oil. No half measures now, give it all you've got! I'll be watching from here.
Okay.
Remind me about that potion?
Have you finished making the Shocking Essential Oil?
Still working on it...
Shocking Essential Oil is made from electro crystal and frog.
It shouldn't be too hard to find them when you're out and about. Gathering raw materials is a major part of the alchemist's work, you'll just have to get used to it.
When you've found them, try making some Shocking Essential Oil and show me how it turns out.
Yes, it's ready.
Nice work! This is some genuine bona fide Shocking Essential Oil alright. It helps people channel Electro energy more easily.
Now, let me tell you what happens if you swap the frog for butterfly wings!
It produces a powerful Insulation Potion, which protects the taker against electroshocking.
Amazing, isn't it? The very same electro crystal can, depending on the specific alchemical process used, produce two completely opposite effects.
Go on, take this Insulation Potion and get a taste of what alchemy can really do!
Let's have you start by making some Frosting Essential Oil.
It is a foundational alchemical product. The best place for beginners to start.
To make Frosting Essential Oil, you will need a lizard tail and some mist flower corolla.
Both of these are found frequently in the wild— The point of the lizard tail, you ask?
Why, the crispness of a frozen lizard tail makes for a far more appetizing potion!
Hahaha. That was a joke.
Once you've gathered everything, try and create some Frosting Essential Oil. No half measures now, give it all you've got! I'll be watching from here.
Okay.
Remind me about that potion?
Have you finished making the Frosting Essential Oil?
Still working on it...
Frosting Essential Oil is made from lizard tail and mist flower corolla.
It shouldn't be too hard to find them when you're out and about. Gathering raw materials is a major part of the alchemist's work, you'll just have to get used to it.
When you've found them, try making some Frosting Essential Oil and show me how it turns out.
Yes, it's ready.
Wow, that's a mighty fine batch of Frosting Essential Oil you've made! Rub some of this on you to get more in touch with your Cryo side...
But guess what happens if you swap out the lizard tail and use crystal core instead?
Boom! You got yourself a Frostshield Potion, which protects you against the harmful effects of too much playing in the snow, amongst other things!
Amazing, isn't it? The very same mist flower corolla can, depending on the specific alchemical process used, produce two completely opposite effects.
Here's a Frostshield Potion for you. Now, go and get a taste of what alchemy can really do!
Let's have you start by making some Flaming Essential Oil.
It is a foundational alchemical product. The best place for beginners to start.
To make Flaming Essential Oil, you will need a frog and a flaming flower stamen.
You should easily be able to find these outside the city— You want to know why we mix a frog with fire?
Why, flaming flowers have to be diluted with the mucus found on frogs' skin before they are safe for consumption...
I mean... Ah, no! I didn't say anything. I said nothing!
Once you've gathered everything, try and create some Flaming Essential Oil. No half measures now, give it all you've got! I'll be watching from here.
Okay.
Remind me about that potion?
Have you finished making the Flaming Essential Oil?
Still working on it...
Flaming Essential Oil is made from frog and flaming flower stamen.
It shouldn't be too hard to find them when you're out and about. Gathering raw materials is a major part of the alchemist's work, you'll just have to get used to it.
When you've found them, try making some Flaming Essential Oil and show me how it turns out.
Yes, it's ready.
That sure smells like Flaming Essential Oil alright! And you can really feel the heat too.
Did you know that there is a similar recipe using butterfly wings instead of a frog?
Voilà! You have yourself a Heatshield Potion. If you're ever rescuing a baby from a burning building, this little thing will make sure you don't even break a sweat.
Amazing, isn't it? The very same flaming flower stamen can, depending on the specific alchemical process used, produce two completely opposite effects.
Take this Heatshield Potion and get a taste of what alchemy can really do!

(Test) Aha, it's finished! Take it, see if you can find out what it does. I have no idea — but that's the exciting thing about alchemy!
